Mike Reilly Receives Endorsement of United Federation of Teachers

Mike Reilly stated: “I am extremely proud to announce the United Federation of Teachers (UFT) & New York State United Teachers (NYSUT) have endorsed my candidacy for the South Shore State Assembly. I am truly thankful to have the support of our teachers. I will continue to advocate and fight for the resources they need to support our students, families and school communities!”
Mike Reilly Endorsed by the Uniformed Firefighters Association

Mike was joined by UFA President Gerard Fitzgerald, Staten Island Trustee Eric Bischoff, Firemarshall Representative Steven Tagliani and firefighters outside Engine Company 164 – Hook & Ladder 84 on Drumgoole Rd to receive the endorsement.
Congressman Dan Donovan Endorses Michael Reilly

Congressman Dan Donovan endorsed Michael Reilly in his bid to become the next Assembly Member from the 62nd Assembly District. Reilly is running for the seat that is being vacated by current Assemblyman Ron Castorina who is running for Surrogate Judge.
Reilly Racks Up Endorsements in Bid for the 62nd Assembly District

The Staten Island Republican, Conservative and Independence Parties have endorsed Michael Reilly as their candidate for the 62nd Assembly District. The parties join NYC Councilman Joseph Borelli and Minority Leader Steven Matteo in supporting Reilly for the South Shore Assembly seat. The Assembly seat is currently held by Assemblyman Ronald Casterina, who is a candidate for Surrogate Judge.
Minority Leader Steven Matteo Endorses Michael Reilly

New York City Council Minority Leader Steven Matteo today endorsed Michael Reilly in his bid to become the next Assembly Member from the 62nd Assembly District. Reilly is running for the seat that is being vacated by current Assemblyman Ron Castorina who is running for Surrogate Judge.
